title: Choose the visual world
question: Which version feels most like an honest record of who Colton is and what he has done?

options.label: Field Archive
options.lineage: field notebooks, museum specimen labels, and working archives
options.thesis: A life in progress reconstructed from evidence instead of sales claims.
options.viewport: One continuous evidence table: identity first, then service, software, research, and selected work.
options.risk: Can feel overly academic if the personal voice disappears.

raised.raise: Every artifact gets a precise index and state.
Visible imperfection makes the record feel lived-in, not manufactured.
The opening statement owns the page with total hierarchy.

options.label: Flight-Test Debrief
options.lineage: flight-test reports, after-action reviews, and engineering postmortems
options.thesis: Leadership and engineering share one operating record: objective, evidence, result, next move.
options.viewport: A decisive opening brief above a chronological record of service, software, research, and projects.
options.risk: Military language can overpower the software and research story.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.lineage: architectural sections and environmental analysis drawings
options.thesis: One continuous cutaway shows how leadership, study, research, and building fit together.
options.viewport: A horizontal career section crosses the fold, with projects and roles occupying distinct rooms.
options.case: It explains the whole story cleanly, but identifies less strongly with one actual person.
options.risk: Precision can read as distant or overly polished.

options.label: Cut-Paper Self-Portrait
options.lineage: Alan Fletcher posters, cut paper, and crayon annotation
options.thesis: A plainspoken self-portrait uses tactile fragments to show the human behind the résumé.
options.viewport: A bold personal statement sits beside four handmade evidence fragments for service, code, research, and study.
options.case: It feels candid and unmistakably human, but loses narrowly on trust and long-term extensibility.
options.risk: The playfulness can undersell senior responsibility.

options.label: Jackfield Schedule
options.thesis: A black-glass operating board maps roles and projects as active circuits.
options.viewport: Indexed lanes route the visitor through work, service, and research.
options.case: The structure is excellent, but the control-room aesthetic misrepresents the person.
options.risk: Reads as a themed interface rather than a candid portfolio.

options.label: Teletext Index
options.thesis: A direct numbered index makes every fact one keypress away.
options.viewport: Page 100 introduces Colton; numbered pages open the evidence.
options.case: The navigation is direct, but the retro-computer joke would become the subject.
options.kept: Direct address and ruthless index discipline.

options.label: Raku Record
options.lineage: raku pottery and repaired working vessels
options.thesis: A dark material record treats growth and imperfection as evidence.
options.viewport: A quiet dark field holds a few carefully lit career fragments.
options.case: The honesty fits, but the metaphor does not explain software, leadership, or research.
options.risk: Becomes an art portfolio with facts attached.

options.label: Weimar Bill
options.lineage: Weimar cabaret bills and typographic broadsides
options.thesis: A loud public bill makes the personal statement impossible to miss.
options.viewport: One huge statement dominates above tightly packed evidence columns.
options.case: The hierarchy is fearless, but the performance fights the requested quiet confidence.

canonCard.label: Conventional portfolio
canonCard.thesis: A polished hero, project grid, résumé timeline, and contact block executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Name and title above a familiar project-card grid.
canonCard.risk: Easy to understand, easy to forget.
